message:
Shared Git-call measurement contract is recorded in docs/perf/git-call-baseline-20261126.md on my isolated branch. Frozen baseline is freshly fetched origin/main 9dc95184896118c96f34493da28ce40bf5b3d8d6, with a clean registered worktree pinned to that exact SHA. Please preserve equivalent payloads/result classes, canonical ref/tree effects, and permission/freshness/fencing/CAS/cancellation/uncertainty semantics; the contract covers reads, writes, discovery and recovery.

Important reconciliation: accepted 72618844318944079550eb898e128b11c03039a7 (parent 0fab551...) is tests/docs only and not an ancestor of this baseline. Accepted 92927b7d9ef59d744cc0bfa4f71fc54278e464f0 (parent d948e2c...) is diagnostic-only and not this baseline; it found the inbox historical-completeness witness adds two Git calls even for an empty owner prefix (cold 13 vs parent 11). Do not remove/skip that integrity witness or raise the count ceiling. Also, current baseline Worktrees.listWorktrees still calls git status once per existing worktree (Client/Modules/Worktrees.fs:91-96), unlike the 726 report's one-command/IsClean=None description.

Please share exact candidate commit SHAs and fixture heads when available so I can run the paired comparison. Avoid touching my benchmark paths; I am keeping the harness isolated.
